# Homepage artwork

Both images were generated with the built-in image generation tool with `transparent_background: false`. Web delivery uses nearest neighbor resizing and lossless WebP encoding. The files are original decorative artwork and do not depict product functionality.

## Network sphere

Saved asset: `public/images/network-dither.webp`.

```text
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone raster hero illustration for a minimal dark-mode open-source blockchain infrastructure homepage, square 1024 by 1024 composition
Primary request: one floating connected network sphere rendered entirely as crisp monochrome ordered halftone / Bayer dither, a retro scientific computer visualization
Scene/backdrop: a perfectly flat near-black background, RGB #111111, no scene or horizon
Subject: a precise, tactile three-dimensional spherical globe made of a sparse triangulated network surface, thin geodesic connections and occasional small luminous junction points integrated into its surface; strong spherical form with a slightly irregular mathematical topology; substantial white dither across the upper left/front hemisphere, middle gray stippled rolloff, dark right underside
Style/medium: 1980s technical plotter meets early Macintosh 1-bit ordered dither, black/white and neutral gray ink only, distinctly visible tiny square dither marks; stark, graphic, beautiful but restrained
Composition/framing: exactly one sphere centered, sphere diameter about 58 percent of canvas width, generous flat black empty margins on every side, no other floating objects, square crop, not a donut, no rings or orbit lines
Lighting/mood: diffuse upper-left light translated into discrete ordered dither, calm technical artifact, no glow
Color palette: near-black #111111 field, white and neutral-gray marks only; monochrome
Constraints: actual illustration asset only, no website mockup, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no border, no UI; background must be flat #111111 right to all edges
Avoid: torus, donut, planets with continents, starfields, glossy gradients, neon, blue, purple, photorealistic clouds, overloaded connections, scattered particles or marks outside the central sphere
```

## Background terrain

Saved asset: `public/images/terrain-dither.webp`.

```text
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless-feeling wide raster atmospheric background for a very minimal dark-mode technical homepage, approximately 2:1 landscape image
Primary request: a very quiet monochrome dithered panorama of distant rocky mountain terrain, concentrated near the far left and far right lower edges with a completely dark central reading area
Scene/backdrop: near-black #111111 flat empty sky and broad dark central valley, no stars and no moon; barely visible layered rocky ridges at lower corners fading gently into the field
Subject: low, rugged distant rock formations rendered as tiny ordered black-and-gray stipple/Bayer dither, sparse highlights describing faceted slopes, restrained atmospheric depth. Terrain must stay subdued and low contrast, never bright white
Style/medium: early Macintosh technical print, crisp fine ordered dither, monochrome raster halftone, hand-printed scientific landscape feeling
Composition/framing: ultra-wide calm landscape; upper 65 percent almost entirely empty flat #111111; left edge has a subdued mountain slope rising only in the lower third; right edge has a separate slightly taller rocky ridge in lower third; middle 50 percent remains black and empty down to near the bottom; there is no high central peak, foreground subject, or focal object
Lighting/mood: sparse moonless charcoal, quiet and tactile, low-contrast ambient light translated into discrete grey dots
Color palette: #111111 black field with muted charcoal and medium-gray dither marks; brightest terrain values no brighter than about #777777; absolutely no colors
Constraints: standalone background artwork only, no website mockup, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no border, no frame, no UI; clean dark margins at top and sides; subtle enough for white foreground type
Avoid: people, buildings, trees, river, snow, sun, moon, stars, planets, central mountain, bright white foreground, high-contrast horizon, neon, smooth glossy gradients, colored glow
```
